rationale: Add the first CI leg that compiles the iOS GPU (PULP_HAS_SKIA) code path: one iphonesimulator configure+compile leg in the existing iOS compile gate that fetches the manifest-pinned ios-simulator Skia slice, configures PULP_ENABLE_GPU=ON with PULP_REQUIRE_GPU_FOR_SDK=ON, and builds the ios-auv3-gpu-smoke AUv3 and HostApp targets. The new leg immediately surfaced latent drift in the Pulp-owned iOS plugin view host: its PULP_HAS_SKIA half was never compiled by any gate and referenced pointer-dispatch helpers without including pointer_dispatch.hpp, and captured the Metal view with __weak in a file that compiles under manual reference counting. The fix adds the missing include and switches to the __block non-retaining capture the mac hosts already use. No render surface abstraction, no Skia or Dawn backend, no asset pipeline, and no captured or serialized output changes; the iOS host is a Pulp-owned platform adapter, so this touches no accepted expansion boundary and no Vellum source authority, and the disposition is watch-only.
